_comment: Roadmap R1 decision 4 (docs/CharacterAnimationRoadmap.md): the BASE list of states every character of a gait class must be able to play, keyed by BodyPlan.gaitClass. Values are the variant target (outcome G2: >= 3 reviewed variants for high-frequency states; 1 = one clip suffices). Everything else a character needs (attack kinds, movement modes, class actions) is derived from its own D&D data by tools/anim_pipeline/coverage_report.py, so a new species costs no edits here. A plan may add plan-only needs with a 'vocabularyExtra' object of the same shape in its body_plans/*.json.
